Assert.deepEqual(
    accountPreferences.find(account => account.protocol === "pop3"),
    {
      protocol: "pop3",
      socket_type: Ci.nsMsgSocketType.plain,
      auth_method: Ci.nsMsgAuthMethod.passwordCleartext,
      store_type: "mbox",
      login_at_startup: false,
      check_new_mail: false,
      empty_trash_on_exit: false,
      download_on_biff: true,
      headers_only: false,
      leave_on_server: false,
    },
    "The pop3 account should match."

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The accepted collector adds check_time only when check_new_mail is true, NNTP max_articles only when notify.on is true, and POP retention details only within leave_on_server. The days field has its own delete_mail_left_on_server condition. For this metric, preserve the actual per-field conditions instead of emitting a value for every possible protocol preference. This is a scoped source recommendation; the existing test covers default POP3 and IMAP objects, not the active NNTP and nested POP branches. No telemetry test was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.
title: Account-preference telemetry omits inactive dependent settings
